def: Continuing an interrupted response stream from the last received event instead of restarting it, using event ids or sequence cursors from which the server replays.
practice: SSE clients send Last-Event-ID on reconnect and OpenAI background responses resume with starting_after and a sequence number, while MCP removed SSE resumability in its 2026-07-28 specification, so MCP clients re-issue the request (as of November 2026).
